actions.title: Add sub(a, b) in src/sub.js
actions.body:
## What changed

- `src/sub.js`: a new module exporting `sub(a, b)`, which returns `a - b`. It is marked `Implements: ADR 0001`.
- `test/sub.test.js`: a test that `sub(5, 3)` is `2`, titled `(UC-1, ADR 0001)`.
- `src/add.js` is unchanged.

## Why

Issue #1 asks the library to subtract, so that `sub(5, 3)` is `2`. UC-1 names `src/sub.js`, and ADR 0001 (accepted by the owner) decides that `sub` is a new exported function in its own module.

## How it was tested

- The test was written first and failed with `Cannot find module '../src/sub.js'`.
- After the code was added, `run_test lib` passed (2 of 2 tests), and `run_gate` passed (`node --test`).

## Follows

- Use case: UC-1
- Decision record: ADR 0001

The ADR's Status and its Implementation section are not changed here, because a change pull request may not touch a decision record. Those updates are for the owner.
